title: A-module-valued total Hom complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L^\bullet,M^\bullet$ cochain complexes of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $\operatorname{Hom}_A^n(L^\bullet,M^\bullet)=\prod_{p\in\mathbb Z}\operatorname{Hom}_A(L^p,M^{p+n})$, with its componentwise $A$-module structure and differential $d(z)=d_Mz-(-1)^nzd_L$. This is the $A$-module-valued total Hom complex; its terms and differential use the existing homogeneous cochains and linear Hom differential, without forgetting the $A$-action.
